title: 2025 Annual Ridership Report
text:
2025 Annual Ridership Report
Published 10 March 2026 · Planning team
Summary
2025 was our busiest year so far. Riders took close to one hundred thousand trips, up from 71,000
in 2024. The summer months carried the year: see Figure 1 for the month by month numbers.
Growth came mostly from students and from commuters crossing the river. The two stations near
campus and downtown were the busiest, as Table 1 shows. Lansingburgh grew the fastest from a
small base.

title: 2025 Annual Ridership Report
text:
Operations
Every morning a rebalancing truck moves bikes from full stations to empty ones before the
commute. Figure 2 shows the loop it drives. The route was changed in October 2025 after
complaints that Lansingburgh was empty by 7 am.
What we will do in 2026
Add e-bikes at the three busiest stations, open four stations in Albany, and keep the winter service
running. Winter opening hours are on the ﬂyer posted at every station.

title: Board meeting minutes, 22 April 2026
text:
Board meeting minutes
22 April 2026 · Troy · Seven of seven board members present
1. Albany expansion
The board approved four stations in Albany, opening in September 2026, with a budget of $310,000.
2. Appointments
Priya Raman is appointed Head of Operations from 1 May 2026. From the same date Daniel Kim
takes over as station manager of Monument Square, in addition to Troy Atrium.
3. E-bikes
Sixty e-bikes are ordered for delivery in June. They will be placed at Monument Square, RPI

title: Refund Policy (February 2024)
text:
Refund Policy
Version 1 · In force from 1 February 2024 · Customer care
Faulty bikes
If a bike is faulty, for example a ﬂat tyre, broken brakes or a loose chain, report it in the app within
30 minutes of unlocking it. We refund the ride as account credit. Refunds are not paid back to cards.
Memberships
Annual memberships cost $90 and can be refunded within 14 days of purchase if no rides were
taken.
Lost or stolen bikes
A bike that is not returned within 24 hours is treated as lost. The member i

title: Refund Policy (January 2026)
text:
Refund Policy
Version 2 · In force from 15 January 2026 · Customer care · This version replaces the policy of 1 February 2024.
Faulty bikes
Report a faulty bike in the app within 60 minutes of unlocking it. We refund the full ride to the original
payment card within 5 business days, and add a $5 ride credit to say sorry.
Memberships
Annual memberships cost $95. They can be refunded within 14 days of purchase if no rides were
taken.
Lost or stolen bikes
A bike that is not returned within 24 hours

title: Refund Policy (January 2026)
text:
is treated as lost. The member is charged $950, down
from $1,200, because most lost bikes are now found by their GPS tracker.
